captions.gbp:
Need a scan? Booking with Advanced Medical Imaging takes three easy steps. First, request an appointment online or call us, and let us know your exam and whether you're using insurance or paying yourself. Second, our team calls you back to confirm within one business day. Third, come in for your scan, and your radiologist's report goes to your doctor in 48 to 72 hours. If you're using insurance, bring your doctor's order; we check your benefits for free and take care of the authorization with your plan, and most insured scans happen the same week once your plan approves. If you're paying yourself, most exams need no referral and same-day appointments are often available. On scan day, bring a photo ID, your insurance card and doctor's order if you're using insurance, and any CDs or reports from scans you had elsewhere. We're open Monday to Friday, 8 to 5, in Seminole and at our St. Petersburg 3T MRI center. Coverage varies by plan.

Book online at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.

Two ways to book. Insurance: bring your doctor's order, we check your benefits for free and handle the authorization. Self-pay: no referral needed for most exams, and same day is often available.

The Advanced Medical Imaging waiting room. What to bring: a photo ID; your insurance card and doctor's order if using insurance; CDs or reports from scans you had elsewhere; arrive a few minutes early to check in.
Ready when you are. We'll handle the rest. Call (727) 398-5999 or use the link in bio.
